name: tarot
description: Free Marseille Tarot (Tarot de Marseille) reading online — Jodorowsky method, 7-card spread, offline, EN/RU · Марсельское Таро онлайн, метод Ходоровски

paragraphs: A free, offline-capable web app for reading the Tarot of Marseille. Ask a question, tap Read and get a detailed seven-card reading inspired by The Way of Tarot by Alejandro Jodorowsky and Marianne Costa: the theosophical-sum spread, ten-degree numerology, card pairs, the direction of the figures' gazes, the voice of each card and a safe symbolic step.
Таро Марсель — бесплатное гадание онлайн по методу Ходоровски. Работает без интернета и регистрации.
Технически: алгоритм — engine.js, тексты — data-en.js / data-ru.js, офлайн-кэш — sw.js, описание метода и источники — METHOD.md, тесты — node offline.test.cjs → test-results.json.
features: Free, no sign-up, no ads, anonymous visit counter without cookies or personal data; works offline on iPhone, Android and desktop (add to home screen).
Historic Jean Dodal deck (c. 1701, public domain, Wikimedia Commons).
